# The Code Less Taken

> Evidence-backed alternative computing for working engineers.

The Code Less Taken is an independent technical publication about uncommon languages, forgotten systems, underused techniques, and alternative computing. Its work uses primary sources, reconstruction, and modern comparison to explain how an approach worked, why it remained uncommon, and what still transfers to current engineering.

## Core pages

- [Writing](https://thecodelesstaken.com/writing/): Long-form investigations, field notes, and working artifacts.
- [Manifesto](https://thecodelesstaken.com/manifesto/): Why alternative computing remains a useful engineering resource.
- [About](https://thecodelesstaken.com/about/): Purpose, audience, and editorial position.
- [Contact](https://thecodelesstaken.com/contact/): Sources, corrections, collaboration proposals, and correspondence.

## Editorial standards

- [Editorial method](https://thecodelesstaken.com/standards/editorial/): Sourcing, reconstruction, comparison, review, and maintenance practices.
- [Corrections policy](https://thecodelesstaken.com/standards/corrections/): How corrections are submitted, evaluated, and recorded.
- [Privacy](https://thecodelesstaken.com/standards/privacy/): Site data and privacy practices.

## Feeds and discovery

- [RSS feed](https://thecodelesstaken.com/feed.xml): New investigations and field notes.
- [XML sitemap](https://thecodelesstaken.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs.
